name: RC-B10-0209/2026 – After recital B – Am 4
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on escalating trafficking and exploitation by criminal groups in Haiti
part_text: Ba. whereas on 1 March 2025 the Haitian authorities launched a Task Force operated by the private American military company Vectus Global, whose founder is linked to the notorious Blackwater; whereas this Task Force has been reportedly responsible for killing at least 1 243 people and injuring 738, including children, according to BINUH;
